title: Checkbox
description: Lets users select one or more options, with indeterminate, error and custom styling support.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disables the checkbox. Inherited from an enclosing FormControl when not
set; an explicit `false` overrides the FormControl

props.name: indeterminate
props.description:
Shows the indeterminate (partially checked) state. Controlled: it stays
applied until this prop changes, also after the user clicks

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the input, used in forms

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color of the checked / indeterminate box

props.name: id
props.description: id of the input (defaults to the enclosing FormControl's id)

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted with the form when checked

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input as required (inherited from an enclosing FormControl)

props.name: error
props.description: Shows the error state (also set by an invalid enclosing FormControl)

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error text shown below the checkbox (linked with aria-describedby)

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description: Position of the label relative to the box

slots.name: default
slots.description: Label content (alternative to the `label` prop / slot)

slots.name: error-icon
slots.description: Icon before the helper text in the error state (default: info circle)

vars.name: --checkbox-checked-color
vars.description: Background / border of the checked or indeterminate box (defaults to the color prop's accent)

vars.name: --checkbox-checkmark-color
vars.description: Color of the checkmark / indeterminate dash

vars.name: --checkbox-size
vars.description: Width and height of the box (every size)

vars.name: --checkbox-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the box for the square and rounded shapes

vars.name: --checkbox-gap
vars.description: Space between the box and the label

vars.name: --checkbox-label-font-size
vars.description: Font size of the label (every size)

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import { Checkbox, VStack } from "minerva-design/vue";
const fruits = ["Apple", "Banana", "Cherry"];
const selected = ref<string[]>(["Apple"]);
const allChecked = computed(() => selected.value.length === fruits.length);
const someChecked = computed(
  () => selected.value.length > 0 && !allChecked.value,
);
function toggle(fruit: string, checked: boolean) {
  selected.value = checked
    ? [...selected.value, fruit]
    : selected.value.filter((f) => f !== fruit);
}
</script>
<template>
  <VStack :gap="2" align="start"
    ><Checkbox
      label="Select all"
      :model-value="allChecked"
      :indeterminate="someChecked"
      @change="selected = $event ? [...fruits] : []" /><VStack
      :gap="2"
      align="start"
      style="padding-left: 24px"
      ><Checkbox
        v-for="fruit in fruits"
        :key="fruit"
        :label="fruit"
        :model-value="selected.includes(fruit)"
        @change="toggle(fruit, $event)" /></VStack
  ></VStack>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Checkbox, VStack } from "minerva-design/vue";
const selected = ref([true, false, false]);
</script>
<template>
  <VStack :gap="3" align="stretch"
    ><Checkbox
      :model-value="selected.every(Boolean)"
      :indeterminate="selected.some(Boolean) && !selected.every(Boolean)"
      label="Select all"
      @update:model-value="
        (value) => (selected = selected.map(() => value))
      " /><Checkbox
      v-for="(_, index) in selected"
      :key="index"
      v-model="selected[index]"
      :label="`Option ${index + 1}`"
  /></VStack>
</template>

translationResources.title: Checkbox
translationResources.description: Lets users select one or more options, with indeterminate, error and custom styling support.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Remember me starts unchecked; Checked by default starts checked. Each checkbox toggles independently.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: The newsletter starts subscribed. Toggling it updates the subscription status below.

indeterminate.title: Indeterminate
indeterminate.description: Apple is initially selected. Select all starts mixed, selects every fruit, and clears them on the next activation.

sizes-and-shapes.title: Sizes and shapes
sizes-and-shapes.description: Three sizes and three box shapes: square (default), rounded and circle.

label-placement.title: Label placement
label-placement.description: Place the label at the start, end (default), top or bottom of the box.

states.title: States
states.description: Disabled checkboxes, and required for use in native forms.

custom-style.title: Custom style
custom-style.description: Recolor the box with the --checkbox-checked-color, --checkbox-checkmark-color, --checkbox-box-color and --checkbox-border-color CSS custom properties (on className or an ancestor), or show a custom icon when checked.

error.title: Error state
error.description: error with helperText highlights a checkbox that needs attention.

colors-and-form-control.title: Colors and FormControl
colors-and-form-control.description: color sets the semantic checked color (primary, success, info, warning or danger); children can be used as the label. Inside a FormControl the checkbox picks up the id, description, invalid, required and disabled state.

CheckboxProps.indeterminate: Shows the indeterminate (partially checked) state. Controlled: it stays applied until this prop changes, also after the user clicks
CheckboxProps.name: Name of the input, used in forms
CheckboxProps.onChange: Called with the new checked state and the change event
CheckboxProps.label: Label text
CheckboxProps.aria-label: Accessible label, required when there is no visible label
CheckboxProps.errorIcon: Icon shown before the helper text in the error state
CheckboxProps.helperText: Helper or error text shown below the checkbox (linked with aria-describedby)
CheckboxProps.labelPlacement: Position of the label relative to the box
CheckboxProps.children: Label content (alternative to label; used when label is not set)
CheckboxProps.color: Semantic color of the checked / indeterminate box. For a custom look, set the --checkbox-checked-color, --checkbox-checkmark-color, --checkbox-box-color and --checkbox-border-color CSS custom properties on className or an ancestor
CheckboxProps.id: id of the input (defaults to the enclosing FormControl's id)
CheckboxProps.value: Value submitted with the form when checked
CheckboxProps.aria-describedby: Extra ids of elements describing the checkbox (aria-describedby)
CheckboxProps.aria-labelledby: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the checkbox
CheckboxProps.style: Inline styles of the label element

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Remember me starts unchecked; Checked by default starts checked. Each checkbox toggles independently.

select-all.title: Select all (indeterminate)
select-all.description: The parent box follows its children through minerva-change: checked when all are, indeterminate (aria-checked="mixed") when only some are.

styles-states.title: Styles and states
styles-states.description: Sizes, shapes, colors, label placement, a custom icon in the icon slot, read-only and error states with helper text.

form.title: In a form
form.description: Form-associated: a checked box submits its value under name, required blocks submission until it is checked, and reset restores the checked attributes.

props.readOnly: Read-only: focusable and submitted, but the user cannot toggle it.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The checked state changed (re-dispatched from the inner input).
events.minerva-change: The user toggled the box; detail: { checked, value }.

slots.default: Label content (alternative to the label attribute).
slots.icon: Custom icon shown inside the box when checked.

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.click: Clicks the inner control (toggles it unless disabled or read-only).
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
